purpose: Define a read-only Expose monitor for label extraction, translation coverage, fallback resolution and accidental identifier localization.

topics.name: Localization Monitor
topics.purpose: Define a read-only Expose monitor for label extraction, translation coverage, fallback resolution and accidental identifier localization.

semantics.identity_rule: Label key, target identity, context and translated values remain distinct.
semantics.action_rule: Edit/fix actions invoke separate authorized Localization Editor operations.
semantics.authority_rule: Viewing localization data grants no edit/target authority.
semantics.redaction_rule: User-generated/private content is not exposed merely for localization monitoring.

invariants.rule: Localized labels are context-bearing presentation resources mapped to stable canonical identities; translation never changes command names, internal identifiers or semantic identity.

hard_gates.condition: private user content exposed as translation inventory
